8*10/100M POE+1*Gigabit SFP or higher standard
Order without power supply but requires step-up(DC24V voltage input and DC48V POE output)
Din mount
POE watchdog
About POE watchdog
For the samples, we will also send a new model with POE watchdog(2pcs), see below photo.
and also the model we previously discussed without POE watchdog(2pcs), see below photo.
About the voltage booster/DC converter/Step-up, it is fine, see below photo
We will not put in original/standard AC-DC converter, and send step-up instead
Totally there are 4 pieces(2 with POE watchdog and 2 without POE watchdog)
For those 4 pieces, we will send
1 piece with POE watchdog, with original/standard AC-DC converter
1 piece with POE watchdog, with step-up instead
1 piece without POE watchdog, with original/standard AC-DC converter
1 piece without POE watchdog, with step-up instead
By doing this, you could fully test and understand the product features.
About Din mounting kit
